name: MonarchAiPromptInput
title: AiPromptInput
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.text.BasicTextField (TextFieldState) with androidx.compose.foundation.content.contentReceiver and Modifier.imePadding, MonarchAiAttachmentTray, MonarchButton and MonarchAiStopButton
summary: The prompt box of an AI conversation: text that grows with the prompt, Send that becomes Stop while a response runs, attachments, a slot for slash commands and mentions, a toolbar, a character counter and a token estimate.
whenToUse: At the bottom of an assistant conversation or an AI panel, where the person writes the next prompt.
whenNotToUse: For messages between people, use MonarchMessageComposer (mentions, reply and edit modes, drafts). For a one-line question, use MonarchSearchBar or MonarchTextField.
api: @Composable public fun MonarchAiPromptInput(label: String, state: TextFieldState, onSubmit: suspend (String) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, enabled: Boolean = true, busy: Boolean = false, showLabel: Boolean = false, submitOn: MonarchAiPromptInputSubmitOn = MonarchAiPromptInputSubmitOn.Enter, minLines: Int = 1, maxLines: Int = 8, maxLength: Int? = null, warnAt: Float = 0.9f, countTokens: ((CharSequence) -> Int)? = null, attachments: List<MonarchAiAttachmentTrayFile> = emptyList(), accept: List<String> = listOf("image/*"), keyboardPadding: Boolean = true, placeholder: String? = null, disabledReason: String? = null, focusRequester: FocusRequester? = null, labels: MonarchAiPromptInputLabels = MonarchAiPromptInputLabels(), onStop: (() -> Unit)? = null, onAttach: (() -> Unit)? = null, onReceiveFiles: ((List<Uri>) -> Unit)? = null, onRemoveAttachment: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, onRetryAttachment: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, attachIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, sendIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, triggerMenu: (@Composable (value: TextFieldValue, onValueChange: (TextFieldValue) -> Unit) -> Unit)? = null, toolbar: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, footer: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null)
public enum class MonarchAiPromptInputSubmitOn { Enter, CtrlEnter }

public class MonarchAiPromptInputLabels(placeholder: String? = null, send: String? = null, stop: String? = null, attach: String? = null, dropHint: String? = null, counter: ((count: Int, max: Int) -> String)? = null, counterLabel: ((count: Int, max: Int) -> String)? = null, counterWarning: ((remaining: Int) -> String)? = null, counterOver: ((over: Int) -> String)? = null, tokens: ((count: Int) -> String)? = null, attachments: MonarchAiAttachmentTrayLabels = MonarchAiAttachmentTrayLabels())

options.name: label
options.description: The accessible name of the text field, such as "Message the assistant". Shown above the box with showLabel.

options.name: state
options.description: The text. The app owns it, so it can save and restore a draft (rememberTextFieldState survives configuration changes).

options.name: onSubmit
options.description: Receives the text as typed. The field clears at once; if onSubmit throws, the text comes back unless something new was typed.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the prompt input.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Off, nothing can be typed or sent.

options.name: busy
options.description: A response is running: Send becomes MonarchAiStopButton and Escape calls onStop.

options.name: showLabel
options.description: Shows the label above the box.

options.name: submitOn
options.description: Which hardware key sends: Enter (Shift+Enter adds a line) or Ctrl+Enter. Ctrl+Enter sends with either.

options.name: minLines
options.description: The fewest visible lines.

options.name: maxLines
options.description: The lines the text grows to before it scrolls.

options.name: maxLength
options.description: The most characters. Shows the counter; over the limit sending is off and the field has an error. The text is never cut.

options.name: warnAt
options.description: The share of maxLength at which the counter turns to the warning color and the characters left are announced.

options.name: countTokens
options.description: Estimates tokens for the "≈ N tokens" readout. Called on every change.

options.name: attachments
options.description: The attached files, shown by MonarchAiAttachmentTray inside the box. Allow sending without text.

options.name: accept
options.description: The MIME types onReceiveFiles takes from the keyboard, the clipboard and drag and drop.

options.name: keyboardPadding
options.description: Pads the component by the on-screen keyboard with Modifier.imePadding(), so a prompt docked at the bottom stays above it.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Shown while the text is empty; the built-in "Send a message…" without it.

options.name: disabledReason
options.description: Why the input is disabled, shown under it while enabled is false.

options.name: focusRequester
options.description: Moves focus to the text field itself (not the box, whose first focus stop may be the attach button), for example when the panel that holds the input opens.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings, including the attachment tray's.

options.name: onStop
options.description: Stops the running response, from Stop and Escape. Without it Stop is disabled.

options.name: onAttach
options.description: Adds the attach button. Open the app's picker (PickVisualMedia or OpenMultipleDocuments).

options.name: onReceiveFiles
options.description: Receives content URIs of files the keyboard sends (image keyboards), pasted from the clipboard or dropped on the box, filtered by accept. Pasted text is still typed.

options.name: onRemoveAttachment
options.description: Removes an attachment by id. Without it the tray's buttons are disabled.

options.name: onRetryAttachment
options.description: Retries a failed upload by id.

options.name: attachIcon
options.description: The attach button's icon; the button shows "Attach files" without it.

options.name: sendIcon
options.description: The Send button's icon; the button shows "Send" without it and is named Send either way.

options.name: triggerMenu
options.description: A menu above the box, given the text with its caret and a way to change both: MonarchAiSlashCommands, or MonarchAiMentionContext with MonarchMentionQuery.find.

options.name: toolbar
options.description: Controls in the bar under the text, after the attach button, such as MonarchAiPromptToolbar or a model picker.

options.name: footer
options.description: Under the box, such as MonarchAiDisclaimer.

states.name: empty
states.description: The placeholder shows and Send is disabled.

states.name: typing
states.description: The text grows to maxLines and then scrolls; Send is enabled.

states.name: near the limit
states.description: The counter turns to the strong warning color and the characters left are announced once.

states.name: over the limit
states.description: The counter and the box border turn to the danger colors, the field has an error that says by how much, and Send is disabled.

states.name: busy
states.description: Send is replaced by MonarchAiStopButton; Escape on a hardware keyboard stops.

states.name: dragging
states.description: While files are dragged over the box it takes the accent fill and border and shows "Drop files to attach".

states.name: disabled
states.description: Muted box and text, disabled buttons, and the reason under the box.

appearance: A rounded box with the surface fill and the input border; the danger border over the limit, the accent subtle fill and border while files are dragged over it, and the subtle fill when disabled. Send is the primary MonarchButton; the counter is muted, then strong warning, then strong danger. All colors are theme roles, so dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The web component keeps its own attachments and opens its own file input; on Android the attachments are hoisted (attachments, onRemoveAttachment) because the app picks and uploads files with its own picker, and onReceiveFiles takes the files that reach the field without a picker through Modifier.contentReceiver: image keyboards, clipboard pastes and drag and drop between apps (the web's paste and drop). The web's triggers and renderTriggerMenu become one triggerMenu slot that gets the text and caret as a TextFieldValue, which is what MonarchAiSlashCommands takes; Escape closing the menu stays with the menu. The web's screen reader hints for Enter and Escape are not added: on a phone the on-screen keyboard's Enter adds a line and Send sends; Enter, Ctrl+Enter and Escape work on a hardware keyboard. Keyboard avoidance has no web equivalent: keyboardPadding applies Modifier.imePadding(). usePromptDraft has no counterpart: the app keeps the TextFieldState (rememberTextFieldState survives configuration changes, and the app may save it). onSubmit gets the text only, because the app already holds the attachments. iOS has no entry for this id yet; the names follow the web and MonarchMessageComposer.
accessibility: The text field is named by label, and over the limit it carries an error that says how many characters too many.
Send and Stop are buttons with 48dp touch targets; with sendIcon or attachIcon the buttons are still named Send and Attach files.
The counter is read as "120 of 4000 characters" instead of "120 / 4000".
Reaching the warning share ("12 characters left") and going over the limit ("3 characters over the limit") are announced once through a polite live region that is always present.
The attachments are the tray's: a traversal group with remove buttons named after each file.
The drop hint is decoration; the state is also shown by the accent border.
edgeCases: Over the limit the text is kept, never cut; sending is off until it is shortened.
Whitespace alone cannot be sent unless there are attachments.
If onSubmit throws after the person started a new prompt, the new text is kept and the old one is not restored.
Pasted text goes into the field; only content whose type matches accept and that carries a URI is passed to onReceiveFiles.
maxLines below minLines is raised to minLines.

Do not put the prompt inside a vertically scrolling parent with keyboardPadding on a screen that already resizes for the keyboard; the padding is consumed, so a parent that pads by the keyboard is not doubled.

examples.title: A chat on the mock transport (Stop, Escape, counter, saved draft)
examples.webExample: A chat on the mock transport (Stop, Escape, counter, saved draft)
examples.template:
MonarchAiPromptInput(
    label = {{label}},
    state = prompt,
    onSubmit = {},
    accept = listOf("image/*", "application/pdf", "text/plain"),
    maxLength = {{maxLength}},
    countTokens = { (it.length + 3) / 4 },
    onAttach = {},
    attachIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Attach, contentDescription = null) },
    sendIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.ArrowUp, contentDescription = null) },
    footer = { MonarchText(text = {{footer}}, style = MonarchTextStyle.Caption) },
)
examples.code:
MonarchAiPromptInput(
    label = "Message the assistant",
    state = prompt,
    onSubmit = {},
    accept = listOf("image/*", "application/pdf", "text/plain"),
    maxLength = 4000,
    countTokens = { (it.length + 3) / 4 },
    onAttach = {},
    attachIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Attach, contentDescription = null) },
    sendIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.ArrowUp, contentDescription = null) },
    footer = { MonarchText(text = "Answers can be wrong. Check important facts.", style = MonarchTextStyle.Caption) },
)

examples.title: Attachments from the picker, the keyboard and the clipboard
examples.setup:
val prompt = rememberTextFieldState()
var files by remember { mutableStateOf(listOf<MonarchAiAttachmentTrayFile>()) }

examples.title: Slash commands above the prompt
examples.setup:
val prompt = rememberTextFieldState()
val commands = listOf(
    MonarchAiSlashCommand("summarize", "summarize", "Summarize the conversation"),
    MonarchAiSlashCommand("translate", "translate", "Translate the last answer"),
)
examples.code:
MonarchAiPromptInput(
    label = "Message the assistant",
    state = prompt,
    onSubmit = {},
    triggerMenu = { value, onValueChange ->
        MonarchAiSlashCommands(
            value = value,
            onValueChange = onValueChange,
            commands = commands,
            onSelect = { command -> "/${command.name} " },
        )
    },
)

examples.title: Disabled, with the reason
examples.code:
MonarchAiPromptInput(
    label = "Message the assistant",
    state = rememberTextFieldState(),
    onSubmit = {},
    enabled = false,
    disabledReason = "Connect a provider to start.",
    footer = { MonarchText(text = "Answers can be wrong. Check important facts.") },
)
